Screenshots checked.

features.name: SM-2 scheduler (domain)
features.description: Pure-Dart SRS in lib/core/srs/: word states New → Learning → Review → Mastered, intervals 1d → 3d → prev × ease (default 2.5, lowered by misses), Mastered at interval ≥ 21d, any miss → Learning, quiz wrong overrides 'knew it'. Done when: unit tests cover every transition and interval rule.
features.evidence: 2026-11-04: ./init.sh green — format 0 changed, analyze no issues, 25/25 tests (test/core/srs/sm2_scheduler_test.dart covers New→Learning, Learning→Review, Review→Mastered, Mastered stays, miss→Learning from any state, 1→3→×ease ladder, almost < knew, ease floor 1.3, quiz-wrong override; test/core/core_purity_test.dart guards lib/core imports).

features.name: Session builder (domain)
features.description: Builds a daily session: due reviews oldest first, then new words up to the profile's daily goal, 'didn't know' cards re-queued at the end. Done when: unit tests cover ordering, daily-goal cap and re-queue.
features.evidence: 2026-11-04: ./init.sh green — format 0 changed, analyze no issues, 43/43 tests. test/core/session/session_builder_test.dart covers due-first oldest-first ordering (+ id tie-break), not-yet-due excluded, Mastered resurfacing, daily-goal cap incl. earlier sessions today, reviews uncapped, skip candidates with progress/duplicates, miss re-queue once at end, first-answer-only scheduling, immutability.

features.name: Kid-friendly visual design + delight pass
features.description: Make the child-facing screens (profile picker, child home, session, summary, and the progress screen once it exists) look and feel made for kids: a playful colour palette and rounded display font, illustrated backgrounds and a friendly mascot on home and summary, bigger pictures on cards, satisfying motion (card entrance, swipe feedback, correct/miss reactions, star/confetti celebration via lottie or rive), optional short sound effects, and tablet scaling (type, card and buttons grow with screen size instead of staying phone-sized). All assets bundled offline with a confirmed free license. Done when: before/after screenshots on phone and tablet for every child screen are reviewed and accepted by the owner; animations run smoothly on device; reduced-motion setting respected; ./init.sh green.

features.name: Phase 1 gate — real-use trial
features.description: Owner's child uses the app 5 days a week for 2 weeks without being pushed. Human gate: only the owner can mark this done.

features.name: Session budget for review backlogs
features.description: Owner chose option A on 2026-11-05. Reviews are uncapped today: a simulation with the real scheduler shows sessions grow to ~40 cards by week 3 of daily use, ~50 on Mondays after weekends off, ~100 after a 10-day break and ~200 after a 3-week holiday. The profile's 'minutes per day' setting is stored but not enforced. Proposed: a per-session card budget from the profile's daily minutes; most-overdue reviews first, the rest wait for tomorrow; no new words on a catch-up day. Done when: no session exceeds the budget; the backlog drains over the following days in a simulation test; new words pause while behind.
features.evidence: 2026-11-05: ./init.sh green — format 0 changed, analyze no issues, 148/148 tests. test/core/session/session_budget_test.dart (12): cards for minutes (5→12, 10→25, 15→37, 30→75, floor 5); reviews capped most-overdue first; new words pause when reviews fill the session; new words fill only the room left; light day gets full new words; no budget = old behaviour; retries are extra practice. Simulation with the real SM-2 scheduler (80% knew, 10 min = 25 cards): 8 weeks daily — max 25 cards/session, 171 new words learned (uncapped would be 280 new but sessions of ~60 cards); school-week (5/7 days) — max 25; after a 3-week break — 25-card sessions, 7 review-only days, then new words resume. test/features/session_controller_test.dart: 30 due reviews + 5-minute profile → 12 cards, oldest first, no new words; child-home preview shows 12 reviews / 0 new. test/features/profiles_flow_test.dart: parent form shows 'up to 25 cards'. Device: integration_test/profile_form_on_device_test.dart passed on iPhone 18 Pro and iPad Pro 13 simulators; screenshots checked.

A wrong quiz answer overrides a 'knew it' swipe (resolveAnswer, AnswerQuality.quizWrong). Kid-styled, sounds and stars like the swipe cards. Done when: widget tests show the quiz round, the override rescheduling a word, and the summary counting quiz results; checked on phone and tablet.
features.evidence: 2026-11-05: ./init.sh green — format 0 changed, analyze no issues, 180/180 tests. test/core/quiz/quiz_builder_test.dart (15): knew/almost only, max 5, ages 4–6 picture only, 4 distinct pictures, no-picture skipped, small pool skipped, 7+ rotation + fall-through, distinct meanings, spelling tiles, deterministic seed, answer checking. test/core/session/session_summary_test.dart: quiz wrong overrides 'knew', quiz counts. test/features/session_controller_test.dart (6 quiz): quiz follows swipes, wrong answer reschedules as miss (wrongCount 1, correctCount 0), right answer keeps swipe, summary + SessionLog accuracy count quiz, missed words not quizzed, quit mid-quiz keeps answers, 7+ gets all kinds. test/features/quiz_flow_test.dart (4): child UI picture pick with ✓/✗ marks and word repeated, 7+ picture/meaning/spelling with wrong spelling shown, undo a tile, tablet fits. Device: integration_test/session_on_device_test.dart on iPhone 18 Pro + iPad Pro 13 simulators with the real word bank — quiz after swipes, wrong pick reschedules bird, 'Quiz: 3 of 4 right'; 7+ picture/meaning/spelling screenshots checked.

features.name: P2: Placement test + favourite themes
features.description: Onboarding for a new profile (docs/SPEC.md — Onboarding): 20–30 words sampled across levels from the age default, know / don't know with a picture check every few words to catch guessing; start level where ~70%+ are known; the child picks favourite themes, which are preferred for new words; first mini-session of 5 easy words. Parent can skip or override. Done when: unit tests on level choice and anti-guessing; widget test of the whole flow; checked on phone and tablet.
features.evidence: 2026-11-05: ./init.sh green — format 0 changed, analyze no issues, 242/242 tests. test/core/placement/placement_test.dart (20): block at start level spread across the level; 24 words, no repeats; checkable words preferred; missing start level falls back; tiny bank finishes; knows all → top (B1); knows nothing → Pre-A1; knows ≤A1 → A1; start A2, knows Pre-A1 → Pre-A1; 70% boundary (5/6 passes, 4/6 fails); scores pool all blocks at a level; anti-guessing: first checkable 'know' checked at once, then ≥4 words apart, none after 'not yet'/uncheckable, failed check → word unknown, 'know' to everything + failing checks → lowest level, failed checks discount unchecked 'knows', cannotCheck; result known words; firstSessionWords. test/core/themes_test.dart: kid-friendly themes with ≥8 words in appeal order, limit 12, no ZWJ emoji. test/data/repositories_test.dart: favourite-theme words first within a level; 'toy' does not match 'toys'; placementWords/themeCounts by age and level; finish/skip/redo placement; default translation follows the new level, parent's choice kept; editing keeps placement. test/data/migration_test.dart: v2 → v3 keeps children, marks them placed (onboardedAt = createdAt), no favourites. test/features/placement_flow_test.dart (whole flow): kid home → word check (20–30 words, ≥3 picture checks, words spoken) → themes (non-kid tags hidden, pick/unpick) → level/interests/onboardedAt saved → first mini-session of 5 known Pre-A1 words saved as progress; quitting saves nothing; parent adds a child → 'Hand to An' opens the child home; parent skip/redo; parent sets favourite topics. Device: flutter drive integration_test/placement_on_device_test.dart (real bank, age 8, knows Pre-A1+A1) passed on iPhone 18 Pro and iPad Pro 13 simulators → placed at A1, interests [animals, sports]; screenshots build/screenshots/{phone,tablet}-f15-*.png checked. session_on_device_test and levels_on_device_test still pass on iPhone 18 Pro.

features.name: P2: Automatic level progression
features.description: Move up a level when 80% of the current level's words are mastered (parent can override or lock); mix a few next-level preview words into daily batches; if accuracy stays under 50% for a week, suggest stepping back to the parent. Done when: unit tests for the rules; widget test shows the level-up celebration and the parent suggestion.

Step back to Pre-A1 for a while?' and Step back → Pre-A1; Not now hides it and keeps A1; no suggestion at 80%; parent locks the level in the form. Device: flutter drive integration_test/level_progression_on_device_test.dart (real bank) passed on iPhone 18 Pro and iPad Pro 13 simulators — level-up after one 'knew it' at 80%, suggestion for a struggling A1 child, step back to Pre-A1; screenshots build/screenshots/{phone,tablet}-f16-*.png checked (banner first overflowed the phone card — fixed with OverflowBar).
